title: Homology under closed-immersion algebra direct image
statement: Let i : Z ⟶ Y be a closed immersion of schemes. The module direct-image functor over the direct-image algebra preserves homology of short complexes.

source.document: Stacks Project, Sheaves on Spaces and Sheaves of Modules

proof.text: A closed immersion gives a closed embedding of underlying spaces. Import all Sheaf.Topology.ClosedImmersionPushforwardCohomology and apply its existing private theorem TopCat.epi_pushforward_closedEmbedding, the local-lifting exactness step of [lem-sc-cohomology-closed-immersion-pushforward]. This gives preservation of epimorphisms for the underlying abelian-sheaf direct image without reproving the lemma.

The module pushforward to the direct-image algebra commutes definitionally with forgetting to abelian sheaves. SheafOfModules.toSheaf preserves finite colimits by the proved source-library instance, hence preserves epimorphisms, and its faithfulness reflects epimorphisms. Thus the existing closed-embedding pushforward lemma implies that the module direct-image functor preserves epimorphisms.

Module direct image is additive and is a right adjoint by Mathlib, so preserves finite limits and in particular kernels. Apply Functor.preservesHomology_of_preservesEpis_and_kernels to obtain preservation of homology.
